Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

choose — to take one thing from several. Example: I think you should choose the small hotel.
recommend — to say something is good. Example: I recommend the small hotel.
best — of the highest quality. Example: It is the best choice.
reason — why something happens. Example: The reason is that it is cheaper.
advantage — a good point. Example: One advantage is that it is near the beach.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I recommend ...
• It is the best choice.
• The reason is ...
• One advantage is ...
• I think you should choose ...
